rules.name: Registry Run Key Modification
rules.description: Detect modification of HKLM/HKCU Run/RunOnce keys
rules.query: AuditLogs | where OperationName contains "registry" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), InitiatedBy | where count_ > 5 // AZ-PERSISTENCE-147
